name: concretetrack
description: Plantas de Hormigón Elaborado, Despacho de Mixers, Reloj Fraguado CIRSOC 201 y Laboratorio de Probetas

scripts.version:bump: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('version.json', 'utf8')); const parts = v.version.slice(1).split('.'); parts[2] = String(Number(parts[2]) + 1).padStart(2, '0'); const nextSemver = parts.join('.'); v.version = 'v' + nextSemver; v.cacheName = 'concretetrack-cache-' + v.version; fs.writeFileSync('version.json', JSON.stringify(v, null, 2) + '\n'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); pkg.version = nextSemver; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n'); let sw = fs.readFileSync('sw.js', 'utf8'); sw = sw.replace(/concretetrack-cache-v\d+\.\d+\.\d{2}/, v.cacheName); fs.writeFileSync('sw.js', sw); console.log(v.version);"
